terms.definition: One physical object of a [[title]]. A copy is lent to one [[member]] at a time.
avoid: "item" (could mean the title or the copy)

terms.definition: A work the library lends, such as a novel or a DVD, however many [[copy]] of it exist. It sets the [[loan-period]].
The day by which a [[loan]] must be returned. It has no time of day.
The 7 days after the [[due-date]] in which an [[overdue-loan]] can still be renewed.
A [[member]] borrowing one [[copy]] until its [[due-date]]. A loan ends when the copy is returned.
The number of days a [[copy]] is lent for, set per [[title]]. A novel is 21 days, a DVD 7 days.
avoid: "borrowing period" (ambiguous: the time a member has had the copy)

terms.definition: A [[loan]] whose [[due-date]] is before today and whose [[copy]] is not returned.
Moving the [[due-date]] of a [[loan]] to a later day, without returning the [[copy]].
How many times one [[loan]] can get a [[renewal]]: 2.
A [[member]]'s request for a [[title]] whose [[copy]] objects are all lent. It stays until the member gets a copy or cancels it.
A person registered with the library who can borrow a [[copy]]. Has a [[member-status]].
Whether a [[member]] may borrow and renew: `active` or `suspended`. A member is suspended, for example, because of unpaid fees.
A library employee who works with a [[loan]] at the desk on behalf of a [[member]].

questions.title: Does a suspended member keep their reservations?
questions.text: A suspended [[member]] (see [[member-status]]) can no longer borrow. It is unclear whether their [[reservation]] still blocks the renewals of other members.
questions.resolution: Yes. The reservation stays and blocks renewals until the member cancels it or the library removes it. Decided by the head of lending on 2026-10-14.

questions.title: Does a renewal by a staff member count towards the renewal limit?
questions.text: A [[staff-member]] can renew beyond the [[renewal-limit]]. We have not decided whether such a [[renewal]] counts, so that the member can no longer renew online afterwards.
